words: Your whole job in SMS: prepare the player list and content in the Team Engagement File. Retention Team Admin sends the SMS.
The player group the SMS is for. The wrong segment reaches the wrong player and breaks the reports.
The brand search line in the SMS, for example "Cari :  LPK  777". Copy it exactly, spacing included; never auto-correct it.
The long dash. Never use it in an SMS: the vendor mis-encodes it.
When the promo ends. For a 3-day promo, line the expiry up with the latest update date and make sure it has not passed.

tour.label: Ready?
tour.title: Before you hand the list to Admin
items: Every player is under the right segment, category and today's date
SMS text: under 160 characters, no em dash, Cari tag exact
tour.done: All four: hand over to Retention Admin.
tour.notYet: Fix it first. Never hand over expired content or a wrong segment.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Six steps
items: Confirm the segments are current before you change anything.
Record players under the correct segment, category and date (not a past or future date).
Remove duplicates and fill gaps before saving.
3-day promo: line the expiry up with the latest update date.
Double-check every entry, then hand over. Admin sends.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Send the SMS yourself. Your part ends at the list.
Use an em dash or change the Cari tag spacing.

tour.label: Who sends
tour.title: Who presses Send?
tour.q: Is the list ready and checked?
tour.yes: Hand it to Retention Team Admin. Admin sends the SMS from the SMS platform.
tour.no: Keep working the list. Nothing goes to Admin until it passes every check.

pool.why: VIP CS responsibility ends at list preparation. Retention Team Admin sends the SMS.

pool.q: What is the length limit for the SMS?
Why is the em dash banned in SMS?
pool.why: The vendor mis-encodes the em dash, so it never goes in an SMS.

pool.q: The Cari tag looks like it has an extra space. What do you do?
pool.why: Copy the Cari tag exactly, spacing included. Never auto-correct it.

pool.q: The promo in the list expired yesterday. What do you do?
o: Do not hand over expired content; fix or remove it
pool.why: Never hand over expired content. Verify the expiry date first.

pool.q: A player appears twice in the list. Why does it matter?
pool.why: Remove duplicates before saving to prevent double-counting.

pool.q: You are adding today's players. Which date do you file them under?
pool.why: Record under the correct segment, category and date, not a previous or future date.
